responsibility: Declares the option-based severity override engine used by diagnostics::context. diagnostics::option_classifier stores per-option kind overrides, a location-ordered history of pragma-induced changes, and a push/pop stack for nested diagnostic state, providing the interface for recording and querying whether a warning option currently maps to warning, error, ignored, or unspecified before context emits a diagnostic.
same_name_distinction: This header is the interface and data-layout half of the option-classifier pair: it declares option_classifier, its history records, and query/update operations, while option-classifier.cc implements the override, stack, pragma, and PCH behavior.
